name: Boku Kano ~ Boku ga Kanojo o Aishita Keii ni Tsuite
original_name: ボクカノ ～僕が男の娘を愛した経緯について
source:
He came to the Ohshikouchi Estate to tutor the esteemed family's son and daughter. However, he was greeted by two young daughters only. Or rather, the son was so beautiful that his gender could be mistaken. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180405060513/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE059538.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
他受聘来到名门望族凡河内家的宅邸，为这家的少爷与千金担任家庭教师。然而前来迎接他的，却只有两位妙龄千金——更准确地说，那位少爷生得实在太过美貌，简直令人错认性别。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180405060513/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE059538.html]DLsite English[/url]]
